description: This file defines the DatatypeService interface in Java, which declares methods related to handling custom datatypes and their handlers within the OpenMRS framework. It includes method signatures for retrieving datatypes, handlers, and storage objects, as well as for creating, updating, and deleting ClobDatatypeStorage instances.

methods.name: getAllDatatypeClasses
methods.description: Returns a set of all custom datatype classes registered by core and modules.

methods.name: getAllHandlerClasses
methods.description: Returns a set of all custom datatype handler classes registered by core and modules.

methods.name: getDatatype
methods.description: Instantiates and returns a custom datatype of the specified class with the given configuration; may throw CustomDatatypeException.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the default handler for a given custom datatype, configured with the specified handler configuration.

methods.name: getHandlerClasses
methods.description: Returns a list of handler classes suitable for the specified custom datatype class.

methods.name: getClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Retrieves a ClobDatatypeStorage object by its integer ID.

methods.name: getClobDatatypeStorageByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ClobDatatypeStorage object by its UUID.

methods.name: saveClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Creates or updates a ClobDatatypeStorage object in the database.

methods.name: deleteClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Deletes a ClobDatatypeStorage object from the database.
